2110056827333624176.en_summary: @StockSavvyShay says $AMAT is targeting 54% gross margins and 40% operating margins by 2030 while planning to return about 90% of FCF to shareholders. Service revenue is expected to exceed $12B as chipmakers maintain and upgrade equipment. Applied is also expanding into the $KLAC inspection market with eBeam expected to reach $2B this year, while doubling R&D and manufacturing capacity for complex AI chips, HBM and advanced packaging.
2110056827333624176.zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay 表示 $AMAT 目標在 2030 年前達到 54% 毛利率與 40% 營業利益率，並計劃將約 90% 自由現金流回饋股東。服務收入預期將超過 120 億美元，因晶片廠持續維護與升級設備。應用材料亦擴張進入 $KLAC 檢測市場，電子束業務今年料達 20 億美元，並加倍研發與產能以支援複雜 AI 晶片、HBM 與先進封裝。
2110056827333624176.ko_summary: @StockSavvyShay는 $AMAT이 2030년까지 매출총이익률 54%, 영업이익률 40%를 목표로 하며 FCF의 약 90%를 주주에게 환원할 계획이라고 했다. 서비스 매출은 120억 달러를 넘을 전망이며, $KLAC 검사 시장으로 eBeam 사업을 확장해 올해 20억 달러에 이를 수 있고 AI 칩·HBM·첨단 패키징을 위해 R&D와 생산능력을 두 배로 늘린다고 했다.

ticker_notes.AMAT: 2030 年目標毛利率 54%、營業利益率 40%；服務收入料超 120 億美元；電子束業務今年料達 20 億美元

2110058735528009936.en_summary: @Beth_Kindig reports GlobalFoundries $GFS has partnered with TSMC $TSM to expand fab capacity in New York for silicon interposers for TSMC's CoWoS packaging under a $2 billion, five-year deal, with production expected to ramp in early 2028. Tagged $NVDA $AMD $AVGO.

ticker_notes.GFS: 與 TSM 簽 20 億美元五年矽中介層產能協議，2028 年初放量
